006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.format;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.stream.Collectors;
010import java.util.stream.Stream;
011
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
013import dev.metaschema.core.model.IMetapathQueryable;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015
016/**
017 * A named segment of a path that can be formatted.
018 */
019public interface IPathSegment extends IMetapathQueryable {
020  /**
021   * Get the path for this node item using the provided formatter.
022   *
023   * @param formatter
024   *          the path formatter to use to produce the path
025   *
026   * @return the formatted path
027   */
028  @NonNull
029  default String toPath(@NonNull IPathFormatter formatter) {
030    return formatter.format(this);
031  }
032
033  /**
034   * Apply formatting for the path segment. This is a visitor pattern that will be
035   * called to format each segment in a larger path.
036   *
037   * @param formatter
038   *          the path formatter
039   * @return a textual representation of the path segment
040   */
041  @NonNull
042  String format(@NonNull IPathFormatter formatter);
043
044  /**
045   * Get a list of path segments, starting at the root and descending.
046   *
047   * @return a list of path segments in descending order
048   */
049  @SuppressWarnings("null")
050  @NonNull
051  default List<IPathSegment> getPath() {
052    return getPathStream().collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList());
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Get a stream of path segments, starting at the root and descending.
057   *
058   * @return a stream of path segments in descending order
059   */
060  @NonNull
061  Stream<? extends IPathSegment> getPathStream();
062
063  /**
064   * Get the value associated with the path segment.
065   *
066   * @return the value or {@code null} if no value is associated with this path
067   *         segment
068   */
069  @Override
070  INodeItem getNodeItem();
071}
